mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in two months indicates a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods following a 5% drop in HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods following a 0.5% rise in UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in two months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following a 1% rise in RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over three months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following a 1% increase in INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following a 200,000 increase in PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it indicates inflationary pressure in a high-interest-rate environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rate environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods meeting the trigger conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% in a quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows < 1% in 3 months and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods meeting the trigger conditions (t-test p > 0.05).
